constructs.invariant: A caller-supplied nest prefix is not replaced with an invented literal route.
A nested fallback may answer unmatched paths differently from the outer fallback; route facts alone do not certify response behavior.
route_layer affects only previously declared routes; an added route or an unmatched path is not presumed protected.
